messages.subject: Project Tempest — draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Nina,

Attached is the draft Series B term sheet reflecting the headline terms: £18m new money at a £42m pre-money (£60m post), £3.00/share, 1x non-participating liquidation preference and broad-based weighted-average anti-dilution. Marisdale lead at £12m, Westbridge co-invest £6m.

Worth a call before we send to Birchall Stone? The exclusivity and the founder vesting are the points I'd flag for you.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
